Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: After confirming that John, Count Palatine of Neumarkt was the son of Rupert III (Rupert, King of the Romans), the Planner incorrectly concluded that Catherine’s father-in-law was John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy. This is a misattribution/confusion of historical figures named John, ignoring the established evidence that Rupert III was the father-in-law. The Planner prematurely declared the task complete without consistency checking.
